description: Land Acquisition - Wilgamuwa, Alawwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Correction Notice Ex. Gaz. No. 2158/39 dated 17.01.2020 Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, claimants, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
